notes: Big, family-hauling triple sit-and-stand (54 in long unfolded, 61 in folded) — the opposite end of the batch from the city/shopping goal; scores low on portability but is the maximum-seating option. Max 40 lb per seat, 44 in / stand-on platform to 45 lb. Ships with TWO universal car seat adapters; Clek Liing attaches via the Joovy Universal Car Seat Adapter (adapter-joovy-universal).
